title: How the loan application process works
content: The loan process has three steps. Step 1: tell us what you need and we match you with the lenders that fit your profile. Step 2: we send you the lender's official online application link on WhatsApp, and you fill it and upload your documents directly with the lender. Step 3: the lender reviews the application and shares the sanction terms with you. Our loan officer follows up with you until disbursal.

title: Documents required for a loan application
content: Keep these documents ready for a faster loan approval. PAN card and Aadhaar card for identity. Address proof such as Aadhaar card or passport or latest utility bill. Income proof: latest 3 months salary slips and 6 months bank statement for salaried customers. Income tax returns of the last 2 to 3 years for self-employed customers. Property papers such as sale agreement or title deed for home loan and mortgage loan. Latest passport size photographs. Our loan officer confirms the exact list for your loan type during the consultation.

title: Loan eligibility basics
content: Loan eligibility depends on your monthly income. Existing EMIs. Credit score. Age. Employment type and the property value. Every bank checks repayment capacity before approving a loan. We work with 20 plus banks and NBFCs and each one has its own rules so the eligible amount differs from bank to bank. Share your basic details and our loan officer will check the best eligible offers for you. The final eligible amount and rate are always confirmed by our loan officer, usually the same day.

title: What Right Agent Group does and how we are paid
content: Right Agent Group is LS Right Agent Services (OPC) Private Limited, a loan consultancy and agent based in Hyderabad. We are not a bank and we do not lend money ourselves. We work with banks and NBFCs to arrange a loan for you, and we are paid by the lender, not by you. You do not pay us a fee to apply. The interest rate, all charges and the final approval are decided by the lender.

title: Fees and charges
content: You do not pay Right Agent Group a fee to apply for a loan. The lender charges its own fees, typically a processing fee of about 0.25% to 2% of the loan amount plus GST, and for property loans legal and technical valuation charges. Insurance is optional unless the lender requires it for a specific product. All charges, the annual percentage rate and the total cost are set out in the lender's Key Fact Statement before you sign. Always read the Key Fact Statement.

title: Key Fact Statement and loan agreement
content: Before you sign, the lender gives you a Key Fact Statement showing the all-inclusive cost: the interest rate, processing fee, other charges, the annual percentage rate, the EMI and the total amount payable. Read it and ask us anything about it before signing. The loan agreement is signed with the lender, and the approved amount is credited to your bank account after the lender's verification and disbursal.
